sample_source.selection: Uniform without replacement; identical conversations across checkpoints; outputs unchanged.
sample_source.source_type: Team-authored project development validation inputs, not public-corpus examples or locked project test.
sample_source.reply_source: Model-generated STANDARD followed by LOCAL_REWRITE conditioned on that exact generated STANDARD; not authored reference replies.

architecture.output_head: Independent stored output head retained with compatibility loader

shared_task_settings.training: Shared LoRA over frozen adapted base; mixed tasks, not sequential independent English/Singlish adapters
shared_task_settings.loss: Reply-token cross entropy; no RL/DPO/reranker in these inference routes

stages: Conversation plus speaker labels to STANDARD
Same conversation plus generated English draft to LOCAL_REWRITE

comparison_limits: A versus B changes training duration/checkpoint selection only.
A/B versus C changes target corpus, target edits, context-pair supervision, batching/exposures and software/hardware; not a controlled dataset-size-only comparison.
All3 have context in their inputs. C disables additional extracted context-pair training, not conversation history.
